title: Power Platform Technical Lead
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a Power Platform Technical Lead with strong technical expertise to design, develop, and deploy high-performance solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Power Virtual Agents). You will be responsible for architecting and building custom applications, integrating them with enterprise systems, automating workflows, and creating dynamic business intelligence solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and IT teams to ensure seamless integration with other systems and high-quality delivery of innovative, scalable solutions

  

* **Role: Power Platform Technical Lead**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and deploy Canvas Apps, Model-driven Apps, Power Automate Desktop Flows, and Power Pages.
* Build and automate complex workflows using MS Power Automate, integrating with internal and third-party systems like Dynamics 365, SAP, SharePoint, and custom APIs.
* Develop and deploy Power Virtual Agents chatbots for customer and employee automation tasks.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure SQL, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and external systems via Logic App and custom connectors.
* Optimize and refine PowerBI reports using Power Query and DAX to enhance performance, particularly for large datasets, while designing interactive dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across business units.
* Develop automation workflows in MS Power Automate to streamline business processes and integrate with enterprise systems like Salesforce, SAP, and O365.
* Build custom connectors and leverage Azure API Management to integrate Power Platform solutions with external systems and ensure scalability.
* Implement ALM Smart using Cloud - Microsoft Azure DevOps, managing version control, CI CD Pipeline, and solution deployment across environments.
* Ensure data security, statutory compliance, and IT governance by applying best practices for user roles, permissions, and Data Loss Prevention DLP policies.
* Provide troubleshooting and support for existing solutions, resolving issues and implementing enhancements to improve functionality.
* Stay updated on new features and best practices in Power Platform and Azure, proactively recommending improvements and innovations.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Minimum of 8+ years working with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, MS Power Automate, PowerBI, Power Virtual Agents).
* Proficient in building Canvas Apps and Power Apps - Model Driven Apps using PowerApps with a strong understanding of the app lifecycle and performance optimization techniques.
* Strong experience with MS Power Automate to create advanced workflows, including custom connectors, Integration amp; APIs, and handling system integrations (e.g., Dynamics 365, Salesforce, SAP).
* Advanced skills in PowerBI, including Power Query, DAX for data modeling, and report/dashboard optimization for large datasets.
* Experience in building Logic App and Azure Functions to extend the capabilities of Power Platform applications.
* Skilled in creating custom connectors to integrate external APIs and systems with Power Platform using REST APIs and Azure API Management.
* Experience with Power Platform Component Framework for building custom controls and extensions for apps.
* Proficient in Cloud - Microsoft Azure DevOps, implementing CI CD Pipeline for Power Platform solutions, and managing source code through version control systems.
* Strong experience in security management within Power Platform, including setting up Access and Authorization RBAC, implementing Data Loss Prevention DLP policies, and ensuring compliance with data governance best practices.
* Proficient in Jscript, TypeScript, and C for custom development and creating reusable components for PowerApps and MS Power Automate.
* Familiarity with Powershell for automating Power Platform deployments, handling environment configurations, and managing solutions.
* Deep knowledge of GCP integration, particularly with Azure SQL, Azure Functions, and other cloud-native technologies to extend Power Platform capabilities.
* Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to mentor junior developers and lead technical discussions.
* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (DA-100) Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Administration.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience).
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Senior Windows & Endpoint Security Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows & Endpoint Security Engineer to manage enterprise-scale Windows Server environments across on-premises and Microsoft Azure platforms. The role focuses on secure and highly available Windows workloads, Active Directory services, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), security compliance and L3 technical support. The position is based in Pune and sits within Data Center Operations.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Administer Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022 environments at enterprise scale, covering build, hardening, patching, upgrades, performance, capacity and decommissioning.
* Act as an L3 escalation point for complex Windows Server incidents and technical problems.
* Manage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarding and server health, including antivirus policies, exclusions and agent lifecycle management.
* Collaborate with SOC and Cyber Security teams and support security audits and compliance reporting.
* Drive Windows security baselines, patch compliance, vulnerability remediation and security posture improvements.
* Design, administer and optimise Active Directory Domain Services, including GPO structures, OU design, delegated administration, Domain Controllers, replication, FSMO roles and recovery scenarios.
* Support Active Directory security hardening, logging and privileged access monitoring.
* Administer Windows Server workloads hosted on Microsoft Azure IaaS, including virtual machines, availability sets/zones, scaling strategies, monitoring agents and security integrations. [
* Support hybrid identity scenarios and on-premises-to-Azure migration and post-migration optimisation.
* Troubleshoot Azure networking, VM health, extensions and performance issues, while using automation and operational standards to reduce recurring problems.

**Who you are**
---------------

You bring 6–8+ years of experience working with Windows Server and Active Directory environments.  
You have advanced Windows Server administration expertise and practical knowledge of AD DS, GPO, DNS and DHCP.  
You have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, particularly for Windows Servers.  
You have proven experience administering Windows Servers on Microsoft Azure IaaS and working with hybrid Active Directory environments.  
You can use PowerShell for scripting and automation.  
You understand patch management, vulnerability remediation and virtualisation technologies such as Hyper-V and VMware.  
You bring strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical communication and mentoring capabilities, with a security- and compliance-focused approach.  
A bachelor’s degree in IT/Computer Science or equivalent experience is required. Microsoft certifications covering Windows, Azure or Security are preferred.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

This role provides the opportunity to work with enterprise-scale Windows infrastructure across both on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments, alongside SOC and Cyber Security teams. You will gain exposure to endpoint security, hybrid identity, vulnerability management, Azure migration and automation while contributing to the stability and security of business-critical infrastructure

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

The role provides opportunities to further develop expertise in:

* Enterprise-scale Windows and hybrid cloud operations.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security management.
* Advanced Active Directory security and privileged-access monitoring.
* Microsoft Azure IaaS architecture, availability and migration.
* Security baseline implementation and vulnerability remediation.
* PowerShell-based infrastructure automation.
* L3 troubleshooting across Windows, Active Directory and Azure environments.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

**Role:** Data Support Analyst (Analyst)

**Experience:** 2 -3 Years

**Location:** Gurgaon and Pune

**Business Services Team Overview**

Our Business Services team is a collective of creative, strategic, forward-thinking business enablers. Together, the People & Culture, Marketing & Communications, IT, Operations, Finance and Quality & Risk Management teams make it their mission to ensure Forvis Mazars has the right tools, technology, strategies and services in place to deliver exceptional client service and future-proof our growing firm.

**Job Purpose**

The Data Support Analyst provides responsive, controlled and customer-focused support for database and data-related incidents, service requests and operational tasks. Reporting to the Business Applications and Data Support Team Lead, the role owns tickets through ServiceNow from initial triage to resolution or escalation, keeps users informed and works with application, data, infrastructure and supplier teams to restore service.

The role undertakes routine database administration, monitoring and maintenance tasks for databases supporting critical business applications, while protecting data integrity, security, auditability and service availability. It supports planned changes, service recovery and operational improvement, and helps ensure recurring incidents are converted into knowledge, automation and preventative action.

**Key Accountabilities**

ServiceNow ticket ownership

* Own data and database incidents, service requests and operational tasks from acknowledgement through investigation, resolution, validation and closure.
* Classify, prioritise and progress tickets in line with impact, urgency, service levels and agreed support procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, diagnostic evidence, user communications and resolution notes.

Data and database support

* Investigate connectivity, access, availability, capacity, performance and data-processing issues affecting supported business applications.
* Provide first- and second-line diagnosis using approved SQL queries, scripts, monitoring information, logs and support documentation.
* Engage application owners, database specialists, infrastructure teams, data engineering and suppliers when specialist intervention is required.

Database administration

* Investigate data quality, reconciliation and processing issues, distinguishing source-data, application, integration and database causes.
* Ensure data access, extracts, corrections and administrative activity are authorised, traceable and compliant with security and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Protect confidential and personal data by following approved handling, retention and secure-transfer procedures.

Critical application support

* Support databases underpinning critical business applications, recognising business impact and using appropriate priority and escalation routes.
* Participate in incident recovery, service restoration, post-incident review and preventative improvement activity.
* Support planned changes, release validation, maintenance and operational readiness for new or changed services.

Data quality and controls

* Investigate data quality, reconciliation and processing issues, distinguishing source-data, application, integration and database causes.
* Ensure data access, extracts, corrections and administrative activity are authorised, traceable and compliant with security and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Protect confidential and personal data by following approved handling, retention and secure-transfer procedures.

Knowledge and improvement

* Create and maintain support procedures, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, standard queries and operational checklists.
* Identify recurring incidents and request patterns, contributing evidence to problem management and root-cause analysis.
* Propose automation, monitoring, self-service and process improvements that reduce manual effort and repeat demand.

  

Service communication

* Provide clear and timely user updates, translating technical findings into business impact and next steps.
* Escalate risks, ageing tickets, service-level threats and high-impact issues promptly to the Team Lead and Service Management.
* Contribute to operational reviews, handovers and support coverage aligned to UK business hours.

  

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

**Incident and request fulfilment**

* Manage assigned ServiceNow data and database work, ensuring correct categorisation, priority, ownership and closure quality.
* Confirm resolution with users and capture reusable diagnostic and resolution information.

**Database operations**

* Carry out approved monitoring, user and permission administration, scheduled-job checks, maintenance and housekeeping.
* Record results and exceptions, escalating availability, performance, capacity or recoverability risks.

**Data operations**

* Fulfil authorised data access, extraction, reconciliation and correction requests using controlled, repeatable methods.
* Validate outputs and maintain an audit trail of approvals, scripts, evidence and outcomes.

**Operational resilience**

* Support major incidents and business-critical service restoration, including diagnostics, workarounds and recovery validation.
* Contribute to backup, recovery and continuity checks within assigned responsibilities.

**Continuous improvement and professional development**

* Improve data support methods, monitoring, procedures, operational measures and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of SQL Server, Azure data services, automation, security and IT service management practices.
* Build capability through training, mentoring and practical delivery experience.

**Technical and Professional Skills**

**Essential capability**

**Expected evidence**

**Database support**

Practical experience supporting relational databases in a business-critical environment. Microsoft SQL Server knowledge is strongly preferred; experience with other enterprise database platforms is beneficial.

  

**SQL and diagnostics**

Ability to write and safely execute SQL queries for investigation, validation, reconciliation and controlled operational support, with a clear understanding of production-data risk.

  

**Database administration**

Experience with user and permission administration, monitoring, scheduled jobs, maintenance, performance checks, backup status and capacity management.

  

**IT service management**

Working knowledge of incident, request, problem, change and knowledge-management practices. Hands-on experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform is required.

  

**Application and data support**

Ability to diagnose issues across databases, applications, integrations, scheduled processes and reporting dependencies and engage the correct resolver teams.

  

**Security and controls**

Understanding of least privilege, data protection, audit trails, segregation of duties, change control and secure handling of sensitive information.

  

**Scripting and automation**

Experience with PowerShell, T-SQL or equivalent scripting for repeatable support and administration tasks is desirable.

  

**Communication and collaboration**

Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work across India and UK teams, suppliers, specialists and business users.

  

**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. ITIL Foundation, Microsoft SQL Server or Azure data certification is desirable.

**Person Specification**

* Customer-focused support professional who takes ownership and follows issues through to a reliable conclusion.
* Analytical and methodical, able to interpret symptoms, logs, query results and process dependencies without making uncontrolled changes.
* Calm under pressure and able to prioritise according to business impact, urgency, risk and service levels.
* Disciplined in production controls, approvals, evidence, documentation and secure data handling.

title: Lead Data Architect
description:
Type of contract

Full Time

Location

Gurugram (Delivery Platform), India

Service line

IT

**Role:** Lead Data Architect (Analyst)

**Experience:** 6+ Years

**Location:** Gurgaon and Pune

**Business Services Team Overview**

Our Business Services team is a collective of creative, strategic, forward-thinking business enablers. Together, the People & Culture, Marketing & Communications, IT, Operations, Finance and Quality & Risk Management teams make it their mission to ensure Forvis Mazars has the right tools, technology, strategies and services in place to deliver exceptional client service and future-proof our growing firm.

**Job Purpose**

The Data Architect supports the definition and implementation of the organisation’s data architecture, helping ensure that data is structured, integrated, secured and used effectively across business operations, reporting, analytics, automation and decision-making.

Working with the Senior Data Architect, IT Architecture Team Lead and Head of Data, the role translates agreed data strategy, principles and standards into practical solution designs, data models, patterns and delivery artefacts. The Data Architect provides hands-on architecture support to projects and product teams and contributes to the continued development of the enterprise data landscape.

The role combines data design with delivery support across data modelling, information architecture, master and reference data, integration, data platforms, reporting and analytics. It works collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, India and Group IT, applying architecture governance proportionately and escalating complex or strategically significant decisions where required.

The role is expected to improve the quality, consistency, accessibility and reusability of data while developing strong architecture capability and contributing reusable knowledge to the wider technology function.

**Key Accountabilities**

Data strategy delivery

* Support the Senior Data Architect and Head of Data in translating agreed data strategy into practical designs, standards, roadmaps and delivery activities.
* Contribute to current-state, target-state and transition architecture work for assigned data initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape and improve the value derived from information assets.

Data architecture and solution design

* Produce data architecture options and solution designs for projects, products and business change.
* Maintain accurate views of relevant data domains, platforms, flows, dependencies, risks and opportunities.
* Evaluate options against business value, cost, risk, scalability, security, supportability and delivery complexity.

Data modelling and information design

* Create and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models aligned to agreed business concepts and requirements.
* Define core entities, relationships, common definitions and ownership touchpoints for assigned domains.
* Promote consistent interpretation and use of data across platforms, integrations, reports and business processes.

Data platforms, integration and solutions

* Apply approved patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, APIs, events and enterprise data exchange.
* Design data flows and solutions that are resilient, scalable, observable, maintainable and aligned to non-functional requirements.
* Work with engineering and solution teams to encourage reuse and reduce unnecessary duplication or point-to-point complexity.

Analytics, reporting and AI enablement

* Design reliable data foundations for business intelligence, reporting, analytics, automation and appropriate AI use cases.
* Work with data and analytics teams to improve data accessibility, usability and consistency.
* Support common metrics, semantic definitions and trusted data products based on understood sources.

Data governance implementation

* Implement agreed technical approaches for data quality, metadata, lineage, classification, retention, access and lifecycle management.
* Ensure designs support security, privacy, regulatory, risk and audit requirements.
* Work with data owners and governance colleagues to embed controls without assuming ownership of the wider data governance function.

Delivery enablement and assurance

* Engage early with projects and product teams to shape requirements, options and designs before technology choices are fixed.
* Prepare designs for review through Technical Design Authority and other governance routes, recording decisions, exceptions, risks and technical debt.
* Support delivery teams through implementation, testing, transition, operational handover and resolution of design issues.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or strategically significant decisions to the Senior Data Architect or IT Architecture Team Lead.

Collaboration and capability development

* Work effectively across UK, India and Group IT teams, including collaboration across time zones where required.
* Contribute technical knowledge, reusable patterns and constructive design challenge to architecture and delivery communities.
* Support less experienced colleagues and continue to develop personal architecture capability through feedback, learning and practical experience.

Architecture quality and documentation

* Produce clear data architecture artefacts, including models, diagrams, options papers, high-level designs, standards, patterns and decision records.
* Ensure artefacts are accurate, version-controlled, reusable and accessible to delivery, operations, security, audit and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to the architecture repository and continuous improvement of templates, reference architectures and documentation quality.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

**Working with data leadership**

* Work with the Senior Data Architect, IT Architecture Team Lead and Head of Data to implement agreed data priorities through practical architecture and design.
* Translate defined outcomes and requirements into data models, solution designs, standards and delivery artefacts.
* Provide evidence on feasibility, dependencies, sequencing, risk and design trade-offs, escalating material issues appropriately.
* Maintain traceability between the problem being addressed, agreed architecture decisions and delivered solutions.

**Business partnership and domain understanding**

* Develop a strong understanding of business services, core processes, client service needs, information flows and operational pain points.
* Work with business stakeholders, product owners and process owners to clarify information needs and shape pragmatic solutions.
* Explain data topics in clear language and create shared understanding of options, risks, decisions and expected outcomes.

**Data landscape and roadmap contribution**

* Maintain reliable documentation for assigned data domains, sources, stores, integrations, consumers and dependencies.
* Contribute to roadmaps for data platform evolution, simplification, interoperability and legacy reduction.
* Identify architecture risks, gaps and duplication and propose proportionate remediation options.

**Patterns, standards and reusable assets**

* Apply and improve reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, quality, lineage, security and observability.
* Use consistent modelling conventions, naming standards, metadata practices and design evidence.
* Help delivery teams reuse approved patterns and reference designs rather than creating unnecessary local solutions.

**Governance and design assurance**

* Prepare and present data designs for Technical Design Authority and related decision forums, supported by the Senior Data Architect where appropriate.
* Apply governance proportionately based on business impact, data sensitivity, complexity and delivery risk.
* Record decisions and exceptions clearly and follow through agreed actions during delivery.

**Continuous improvement and professional development**

* Contribute to architecture methods, repositories, templates, measures and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of developments in data architecture, cloud data platforms, analytics, AI and information management.
* Seek feedback, participate in architecture communities and build capability through training, mentoring and practical delivery experience.
* Support colleagues with data architecture practices and provide constructive, evidence-based design challenge.

**Technical and Professional Skills**

**Essential capability**

**Expected evidence**

**Data architecture experience**

Practical experience contributing to data architecture or solution design across business and technology change, with evidence of well-structured and supportable outcomes.

  

**Data strategy implementation**

Ability to interpret agreed data strategy, principles and standards and apply them to project and product delivery.

  

**Data modelling**

Practical experience creating conceptual, logical and physical data models, business entities and common information definitions.

  

**Data platforms and engineering**

Working knowledge of modern data platforms, storage, transformation, orchestration, data products and operational support considerations.

  

**Data integration**

Experience designing or supporting APIs, events, ETL or ELT processes, data exchange patterns and end-to-end data flows.

  

**Analytics and reporting**

Understanding of data warehousing, semantic models, business intelligence, analytics and the foundations required for trusted insight.

  

**Governance, security and quality**

Understanding of technical controls for data quality, metadata, lineage, classification, lifecycle, access, privacy and auditability.

  

**Delivery and assurance**

Ability to support change delivery through timely design decisions, design reviews and clear management of risk, dependency, exception and technical debt.

  

**Architecture documentation**

Capability producing clear data models, diagrams, options papers, high-level designs, patterns, standards and decision records.

  

**Business engagement**

Ability to understand business processes and information needs and translate them into pragmatic data solutions.

  

**Communication and collaboration**

Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to explain technical trade-offs, collaborate across locations and provide constructive challenge.

  

**Architecture practices**

Awareness of relevant architecture and governance good practice, such as TOGAF, together with security, privacy and service management principles. Relevant training or certification is desirable but not essential.

**Person Specification**

* Business-focused data architect who understands that architecture must support practical and measurable outcomes.
* Analytical thinker who can understand complex information landscapes and express them through clear models, options and designs.
* Collaborative partner to data leaders, business stakeholders, engineers and architecture colleagues, willing to seek guidance and escalate appropriately.
* Pragmatic and delivery-oriented, able to balance target-state direction with immediate project and product needs.
* Committed to quality, evidence, documentation and proportionate governance.
* Effective relationship-builder who works well across UK, India and Group IT teams and is comfortable collaborating across time zones.
* Clear communicator who can tailor messages for business and technical audiences.
* Curious, improvement-minded and committed to developing architecture capability and making enterprise data more trusted, reusable and valuable.
* Professional, ethical and aligned to Forvis Mazars values, demonstrating integrity, judgement and accountability.
* Willing and able to work from the India office for a minimum of three days each week.

**Measures of Success**

**Outcome**

**Examples of evidence**

**Data strategy is supported**

Assigned data priorities are translated into clear models, designs, standards and delivery artefacts aligned to agreed direction.

  

**Data is trusted and reusable**

Data assets within the role’s scope are well defined, appropriately controlled and easier to discover, understand and reuse.

  

**Business insight improves**

Reporting, analytics, automation and AI initiatives receive reliable and appropriately governed data foundations.

  

**Architecture improves delivery**

Projects receive timely architecture input, decisions are clear, rework is reduced and operational transition evidence is complete.

  

**Standards are adopted**

Approved data models, principles, patterns and reference designs are consistently applied across assigned change.

  

**Integration complexity is reduced**

Data flows are documented, supportable and aligned to enterprise patterns, with avoidable duplication identified and reduced.

  

**Governance is effective and proportionate**

Material decisions, data risks and exceptions are documented and traceable, with agreed technical controls implemented.

  

**Architecture capability develops**

Architecture artefacts are reusable, repository content is maintained, feedback is acted upon and professional capability grows measurably.

title: Lead Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**About Whirlpool India**

Whirlpool of India Limited, headquartered in Gurugram, is a leading home appliances company dedicated to enhancing life at home and inspiring generations through its trusted brands. The company operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Faridabad, Pune & Puducherry, each reflecting Whirlpool’s commitment to providing best-in-class consumer solutions. Further driving innovation, the company has a Technology & Engineering Center, where India's world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation. In the 2024-25 fiscal year, Whirlpool of India reported approximately INR 8110 Cr in annual revenue and employed 2193 people. More information is available at www.india.whirlpool.in

**About GTEC**

Transforming Vision into Reality: The Global Technology & Engineering Centre. Where India’s world-class talent architects the next generation of home innovation.

**The team you will be a part of**
----------------------------------

The Software Engineering team designs, develops or coordinates development/troubleshooting or debugging of moderately complex software programs for enhancements and new products. Performs high-level design/modeling to convert stakeholder needs into software solutions. Develops software and tools in support of design, infrastructure and technology platforms. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Develops the architectural guidelines, specifications, and technical standards and communicates to stakeholders.

**This role in summary**
------------------------

* Define, govern, and continuously enhance the comprehensive security architecture across all connected home appliance ecosystems (embedded microcontroller/RTOS firmware, connectivity modules, mobile companion apps, REST APIs, and cloud infrastructure).
* Architect hardware-level trust anchors, secure boot chains, cryptographic key provisioning and lifecycle management systems, and resilient Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms at enterprise scale.
* Lead structured threat modeling initiatives (e.g., STRIDE) across product lines, conduct architectural risk assessments, and define mitigation strategies and risk acceptance thresholds for global engineering teams.
* Translate requirements from Whirlpool standards, external regulations, and industry best practices such as US Cyber Trust Mark, NIST IR 8259 / SP 8425, OWASP, and App Defense Alliance (CASA/MASA) into technical product security requirements and solutions.
* Help teams to comply with secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) policies, automated static/dynamic code analysis (SAST/DAST), binary security analysis, and container/pipeline guardrails across global firmware and cloud engineering teams.
* Oversee third-party software component risk management, establish automated Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) tracking, manage dependency vulnerability remediation, and audit third-party firmware and hardware vendor security postures.
* Function as the primary technical advisor on product security to engineering directors, product owners, legal teams, and executive leadership, bridging complex business risk with technical security countermeasures.
* Scope, coordinate, and manage third-party external penetration testing engagements for connected appliance products, embedded firmware, companion mobile applications, and cloud APIs.
* Maintain an enterprise Product Security Risk Register to systematically track, document, prioritize, and manage product security risks, vulnerabilities, and technical debt through mitigation or formal leadership risk acceptance.
* Define strategic defense-in-depth architecture to mitigate risks from AI-driven automated vulnerability synthesis and frontier model capabilities targeting active and legacy IoT appliance ecosystems.

**Your responsibilities will include**
--------------------------------------

* Expert-level mastery of microcontroller security features (ARM TrustZone, TPM, HSM), RTOS security, secure bootloader design, cryptographic key exchange/storage, and secure OTA mechanisms.
* Strong experience in and understanding of programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python and PHP.
* Good understanding of cryptographic algorithms and key management concepts, with proven ability to translate enterprise standards and global regulations into concrete technical security requirements and solutions.
* Deep knowledge of cloud security architectures (AWS/Azure/GCP), secure telemetry ingestion, zero-trust network models, and security for RESTful APIs and WebSockets.
* Demonstrated expertise in local and long-range connectivity security, including Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Wi-Fi, Thread, Matter, TCP/IP, TLS/mTLS, and MQTT.
* Comprehensive understanding of global IoT standards and regulations (US Cyber Trust Mark, NIST IR 8259, ISO/IEC 27402, OWASP IoT Top 10).
* Advanced proficiency with SBOM tooling, software component composition analysis (SCA), and hardware/firmware supply chain security.
* Experience scoping and managing external penetration testing vendors, evaluating security assessment reports, and validating remediation.

**Minimum requirements**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive professional experience in cybersecurity, software engineering, or system architecture, with a dedicated focus on IoT security, embedded systems, and connected device architectures.

**Preferred skills and experiences**
------------------------------------

* Strong expertise in risk management methodologies, threat tracking, leading structured threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE), driving end-to-end security implementations, and maintaining product risk registers for enterprise visibility.
* One or more security certifications such as CISSP, ISSAP, CSSLP, or CISM.
* Deep understanding of AI/frontier model security implications, including defensive strategies against AI-accelerated exploit generation and architectural hardening techniques for legacy embedded platforms lacking modern hardware security anchors.
* Extensive experience leading threat modeling initiatives across complex IoT product lines and defining architectural risk mitigation strategies from initial design through full implementation.
* Demonstrated experience working with global cross functional teams.

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool India. See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.

At Whirlpool India, we value and celebrate diversity. Whirlpool India is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

**Join the Powerhouse of Home Innovation.**

GTEC is more than an engineering centre; it is where the future of the home is being designed, tested, and perfected. We invite you to be part of a team that is not just witnessing the digital revolution but leading it—creating a lasting impact on everyday lives, one innovation at a time.

title: Future Talent - Junior IT Analyst
description:
**Job Title:** **Future Talent - Junior IT Analyst**
====================================================

Job Location:

Pune, India

*At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.*

*And we need people like you to make it happen.*

***We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.***

**Job Summary**
---------------

Future Talent Program is a Trainee Program within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position to start on February or July 2027. You will onboard an individual designed development program for 12 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the program you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person.
  
As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world and this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
  
From day one, you will be delivering results as a true team member following a development plan that is specifically designed for you and your position. The plan includes a combination of project-rotations, international assignments, work within your own department as well as formal training and mentorship from a network of colleagues all over the world. The program will give you broad insight into our company, our culture and our values. After completing this program, you will have gained knowledge, built relationships and had experiences to help you continue your exciting career within our company.
  
We are looking for motivated graduates with a passion for cybersecurity to join our Future Talent Program (FTP) as a Junior Security Operations Analyst. This is a 12 months leadership and development program designed to accelerate your professional growth through on-the-job learning, structured training, mentoring, and exposure to local and global projects.

  

As a Junior Security Operations Analyst, you will support the Security Operations Centre (SOC) in monitoring security alerts, investigating potential threats, and supporting incident response to help protect Tetra Pak’s information and technology systems. You will work under the guidance of experienced analysts, follow established procedures, and collaborate with IT and security teams while building practical cybersecurity skills.
  
This is an individual contributor role based in Denton, Texas and is a full-time, permanent role.
  
he program could start on February or July 2027.
  
Tetra Pak is not considering applicants who require domestic or international relocation.
  
Tetra Pak is not sponsoring work visas for this position.

**What you will do**
--------------------

As a Future Talent Junior Security Operations Analyst, you will:

  

* Monitor and review security alerts from security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), and other security monitoring tools.
* Perform initial alert triage using documented playbooks, gather relevant information, and distinguish potential security incidents from false positives with guidance from senior analysts.
* Support investigations of suspicious emails, endpoint activity, sign-in events, and network activity by reviewing available logs and security telemetry.
* Record investigation findings, actions taken, and supporting evidence accurately in security incident and service management systems.
* Escalate suspected incidents and high-priority alerts promptly to the appropriate teams in line with agreed procedures.
* Assist experienced analysts with incident response activities, including evidence collection and follow-up, and carry out approved response actions under supervision.
* Support the review of vulnerability information and track remediation updates with relevant IT and security teams.
* Maintain clear shift handovers, case updates, and operational reports to support continuity of security monitoring and incident handling.
* Develop an understanding of common cyber threats, security controls, and the organization's systems through practical learning and guided investigation.
* Contribute to improving SOC documentation, knowledge articles, and playbooks based on lessons learned.
* Support basic reporting and automation tasks under guidance to improve the consistency and efficiency of routine SOC activities.
* Collaborate professionally with global colleagues, follow security policies, and handle sensitive information responsibly and confidentially.
* Participate in technical training, mentoring, and development activities as part of the Future Talent Program.
* Make a positive contribution to the health, safety, and well-being of yourself, colleagues, and others around you.

**We believe you have**
-----------------------

* You are a final-year student or recent graduate pursuing or holding a bachelor’s degree in one of the following or a related discipline, with your degree completed before joining:
    
  o Computer Science or Computer Engineering
    
  o Information Technology or Information Systems
    
  o Cybersecurity or Information Security
    
  o Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline with relevant IT and cybersecurity fundamentals
* Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
* A strong interest in cybersecurity, curiosity about how systems work, and a willingness to learn through training and hands-on practice.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, common ports, and firewalls.
* Foundational knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, user accounts, permissions, and system logs.
* Awareness of cybersecurity fundamentals, including phishing, malware, vulnerabilities, authentication, and access control.
* An understanding of the purpose of security monitoring and incident response; familiarity with SIEM or EDR concepts is an advantage, not a requirement.
* Analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to follow procedures, document findings, and ask for guidance when needed.
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate in a multicultural environment.
* Academic projects, internships, cybersecurity labs, capture-the-flag exercises, or relevant certifications are an advantage, but are not mandatory.
* Basic exposure to Python, PowerShell, or another scripting language is an advantage.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, or holidays, where required by the SOC operating model.
* A responsible approach to confidentiality, ethical conduct, and the handling of company information.

**Steps of the process:**

Application review

description:
**Company Description**

Established in 2011 and headquartered in Pune, METRO Global Solution Center (GSC) India is a strategic hub driving METRO’s global transformation. With 1,200+ professionals, we deliver specialized integrated expertise across Master Data Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Marketing & Design, Strategy, Finance & Accounting, Controlling (FP&A), and People & Culture (HR) solutions that drive operational excellence and digital innovation.

By supporting METRO’s sCore strategy, we enable sustainable growth and strengthen business processes. With a solutions-first mindset, we reduce complexity, accelerate transformation, and create measurable value for METRO businesses scaling up globally. METRO is a leading international food wholesaler operating in over 30 countries with a strong network of wholesale stores, digital marketplaces, and food service distribution. It supports businesses that keep the world running, from hotels, restaurants, and cafés to local retailers - offering quality, reliability, and smart solutions that help small and medium-sized businesses succeed.

Headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, METRO AG employs over 85,000 people worldwide and acts as the central management holding company of the group, driving strategic direction, and enabling consistent excellence across all markets. Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for professional customers, which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019.

Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP.

 **Job Description**

**Role purpose**

Work as a direct extension of the onshore Information Security GRC team in Düsseldorf. You support strategic GRC workstreams led from headquarters: ISMS development, AI governance, NIS2 readiness, supplier risk, policy work, and ad-hoc projects. Suits someone who wants substantive analyst-level work close to a senior GRC function, not back-office task processing.

**Key responsibilities**

* Take on analyst-level work assigned directly by onshore GRC colleagues across ISMS, AI governance, NIS2, supplier risk, and policy workstreams.
* Draft first versions of documents — policy excerpts, briefing notes, analyses, risk write-ups, audit responses — for review by onshore owners.
* Conduct desk research on frameworks, regulations, vendor capabilities, and benchmarking to support onshore decision-making.
* Prepare data extracts, summaries, and structured inputs for stakeholder meetings, leadership reviews, and audits.
* Maintain shared workspaces, trackers, and registers; coordinate with business entities and group functions on behalf of onshore colleagues when delegated.
* Pick up ad-hoc tasks across the GRC portfolio as they arise; communicate progress, blockers, and risks transparently.

  
**Qualifications**

**Must-have qualifications**

* 2–4 years in GRC, IT audit, information security, or a closely adjacent function.
* Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 or a comparable framework (NIST CSF, SOC 2); understands risk, controls, and good evidence.
* Strong written English; able to draft clear, well-structured notes and analyses for a senior European audience.
* Self-directed: comfortable receiving a task and producing a structured first version without heavy hand-holding.
* Comfortable with Microsoft 365 and at least one GRC platform (ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust) — or able to learn quickly.

**Nice to have**

* Foundational certification: ISO 27001 Foundation, CompTIA Security+, or working toward CISA / ISO 27001 LI.
* Exposure to AI governance (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF), NIS2, DORA, or supplier risk programs.
* Prior experience embedded in or supporting a European team.

You will be the go-to security partner for product teams, helping them build secure products from design through release by providing secure patterns, practical guidance, and automated guardrails in the SDLC. Beyond threat modeling and security reviews, you will drive vulnerability and supply chain risk management, secure our AI-enabled and agentic features, and raise the overall security maturity of the organization through training, tooling, and community engagement.

We are looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make security the default way of working across BMC’s engineering teams.
  
  
**Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**
  
  

* Serve as senior security SME for engineering by supporting secure architecture, security requirements, and design reviews

* Lead threat modeling including abuse and misuse cases for AI-enabled and agentic features

* Secure coding guidance for Java and JavaScript, manual and automated code review, including review of AI-assisted and agent-generated code

* Triage and validate findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, Container Scanning and secrets scanning, separating signal from noise and driving fixes to closure and tuning or retiring rules that produce more noise than value

* Hands-on security assessments and white-box testing of services, APIs, and multi-tenant boundaries

* Author the secure design patterns, guidance, and reusable components that engineering teams build against by default

* Build and improve automation and guardrails in our existing scanning pipelines including SAST, SCA, Container scanning and other automation in place

* Use AI and LLM tooling to scale security work by finding triage, code review, test generation, remediation guidance — with human verification of the output

* Maintain and tune the existing security toolchain, evaluate and pilot new tooling, bringing a clear technical recommendation when it is time to adopt or drop something

* Drive innovation and maturity in the SDLC with new toolsets and automation for the AI Augmented SDLC

* Track coverage, false-positive rate, time to remediate, and act on what they show

* Review LLM and agent-backed features for prompt injection, excessive agency and data leakage

* Maintain clear security guidelines and controls for agentic code contributions, ensuring code review standards, proper attribution, and appropriate access safeguards

* Implement safeguards that detect and block unapproved or malicious changes introduced by AI agents

* Apply references such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS as practical engineering checklists against real attack paths and write our own guidance wherever necessary

* Maintain supply chain integrity through SBOM accuracy, build provenance, and artifact signing

* Drive risk-based vulnerability prioritization using reachability, exploitability, and EPSS against agreed SLAs

* Serve as technical lead during PSIRT response for significant product vulnerabilities

* Support customer-facing vulnerability communications and drive the systemic fixes that prevent recurrence

* Develop and deliver training, run office hours and threat modeling workshops, and support security champions program

* Maintain expertise in application security, emerging threat vectors, and attacker tradecraft and improve standards accordingly

* Represent BMC’s security practice externally through customer conversations, written content, and conference or community participation

  

**To ensure you’re set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**
  
  

* 6+ years in application or product security engineering with substantial security ownership

* Hands-on experience on Penetration tests, source code reviews and threat modeling or other risk identification techniques

* Strong knowledge of application security testing tools across SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets, IaC and a clear-eyed view of what each one does and doesn't catch

* Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for web, APIs and AI/LLM, including avoidance and remediation techniques, and the ability to explain real exploitability to an engineer

* Knowledge of secure coding practices in Java and/or JavaScript able to read code fluently and submit remediation pull requests

* Experience remediating complex enterprise-level security issues end to end

* Working knowledge of cloud environments (ideally AWS and Azure) and CI/CD pipelines

* A working understanding of how LLM-based features and AI coding assistants change the risk picture and the curiosity to go deeper

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with both engineering and non-engineering audiences

  
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Knowledge of microservices, event-driven architecture & complex structures

* Experience securing or red teaming AI, ML, or agentic systems

* Penetration testing, CTF experience, a hacker's mindset

title: Product Security Engineer (Hybrid Work Model)
description:
**Product Security Engineer**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

Hours of operation: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM CT (UTC

* 6) / 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (UTC+5:30), a nine-hour day. IST hours move one hour earlier while the US is on daylight saving time.
Shift timing: After six months, we may evaluate moving to a second shift of 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM CT (UTC* 6) / 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30).

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on security engineer who likes turning a design into something that runs every day: scanners wired into pipelines, guardrails enforced by policy, findings closed on time, and a monthly report that shows the trend. You enjoy working alongside software engineers, and you use AI agents as a normal part of how the work gets done.

**Job Purpose**

Quorum's products help energy companies operate critical infrastructure, so customers hold us to a high security bar. Our Product and Cloud Security team, part of Global Cloud Operations, owns build-side security: the security of the software we ship and the Azure platform it runs on.

The Director, Security Architect sets the direction and produces the designs: reference architectures, threat models, standards, and guardrails. You are the engineer who puts them into practice with the product and platform teams. You assist in running the Product Security Guild's monthly maturity scoring, operate the application security tooling, implement cloud guardrails, track findings to closure, and produce the evidence that audits and customers ask for.

This is a build and operate role. Success is measured by maturity scores that rise, findings closed within SLA, and controls that are checked automatically.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Maturity reporting:** Run the monthly security maturity cycle for every product and platform: collect evidence, score each product against the security requirements list, publish the report, and keep the Cloud Portal security dashboard current. Move scores from self-assessment to automated evidence wherever tooling allows.
* **Product Security Guild:** Support the Product Security Guild day to day: onboard product security champions, run working sessions, answer questions on the requirements, and keep the requirements list and its guidance up to date.
* **Application security tooling:** Integrate, tune, and operate SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in Azure DevOps and GitHub pipelines. Keep signal high and noise low, triage findings with engineering teams, and track remediation against SLAs in Azure DevOps.
* **Threat modeling:** Facilitate threat modeling sessions with product teams using the architect's templates, record the results, and turn the agreed mitigations into backlog items.
* **Cloud security guardrails:** Implement the Azure guardrails the architect designs: Azure Policy definitions and assignments, Defender for Cloud configuration, and private networking standards, held as code in Bicep or Terraform. Triage cloud security posture findings and drive them to closure with the Cloud Platform team.
* **Secrets management:** Help roll out vault-based secret storage and rotation, and run secret detection so credentials stay out of source code and pipelines.
* **Identity and tenant isolation testing:** Build and run automated tests for customer-facing identity and tenant isolation, so a release that lets one customer reach another's data fails before it ships.
* **Pentest remediation:** Track penetration test and red-team findings from intake to verified fix, coordinate retests, and report status to the architect.
* **Audit evidence and questionnaires:** Gather product and cloud evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, draft answers to customer security questionnaires for review, and keep a reusable answer library current.
* **Incident support:** Support containment and investigation inside the product and Azure estate during security incidents, working within the CISO-led incident response process.
* **AI-assisted delivery:** Use Claude Code and agentic workflows as a default way of working for evidence collection, finding triage, policy authoring, and reporting. Review AI-generated code and configuration before it reaches production, and own the result.
* **And other duties as assigned.**

**What to Bring:**

Security engineering experience (required): At least four years in application security, cloud security, or DevSecOps, with a total of five to eight years in software engineering, platform engineering, or security roles. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field.

Secure SDLC tooling (required): Hands-on experience integrating and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines, with tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk, Mend, GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for DevOps, or OWASP ZAP. You can tell a real finding from a false positive and explain the fix to a developer.

Azure security (required): Working experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, network security groups, private endpoints, and Key Vault. You have written or changed infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform.

Application security knowledge (required): Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, common web and API vulnerabilities, and how they are fixed in code. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.

Scripting and automation (required): Confident with Python or PowerShell for automating checks, pulling data from APIs, and building reports. Comfortable with Azure DevOps or GitHub for pipelines and work tracking.

AI-assisted working methods (required): Demonstrated delivery using AI coding and automation tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, with the judgment to review and verify what they produce. Claude Code experience is strongly preferred.

Certifications (strongly preferred): At least one Azure certification, such as AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer, AZ-104 Azure Administrator or SC-100 Cybersecurity Architect, and at least one security certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP, GIAC (GWAPT, GCSA), CSSLP or CISSP.

Compliance awareness: Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence collection and to customer security questionnaires.

Communication: Clear written and spoken English. You can work with engineering teams across time zones, explain why a finding matters, and keep work moving across teams.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and tenant isolation testing.
* Experience securing AI and LLM applications, including prompt injection and data leakage risks.
* Container and Kubernetes security, including image scanning and admission policies.
* Microsoft Sentinel or KQL for detection and investigation.
* Background in energy, utilities, or other critical-infrastructure industries.

**Additional Details**

Hours of operation: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM CT (UTC

* 6) / 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (UTC+5:30), a nine-hour day. IST hours move one hour earlier while the US is on daylight saving time.
Shift timing: After six months, we may evaluate moving to a second shift of 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM CT (UTC* 6) / 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30).
* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* The first monthly maturity report published, with every product and platform scored once against requirements list v1.
* Security champions named in each product and platform group, with a regular Guild working session running.
* SAST, SCA, and secrets scanning running in the pipelines of at least two products, with findings flowing into Azure DevOps and remediation SLAs agreed.
* All open penetration test findings logged in Azure DevOps with owners, due dates, and a weekly status view for the architect.
* A reusable customer security questionnaire answer library in place, covering the most common product and cloud questions.

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on security engineer who likes turning a design into something that runs every day: scanners wired into pipelines, guardrails enforced by policy, findings closed on time, and a monthly report that shows the trend. You enjoy working alongside software engineers, and you use AI agents as a normal part of how the work gets done.

**Job Purpose**

Quorum's products help energy companies operate critical infrastructure, so customers hold us to a high security bar. Our Product and Cloud Security team, part of Global Cloud Operations, owns build-side security: the security of the software we ship and the Azure platform it runs on.

The Director, Security Architect sets the direction and produces the designs: reference architectures, threat models, standards, and guardrails. You are the engineer who puts them into practice with the product and platform teams. You assist in running the Product Security Guild's monthly maturity scoring, operate the application security tooling, implement cloud guardrails, track findings to closure, and produce the evidence that audits and customers ask for.

This is a build and operate role. Success is measured by maturity scores that rise, findings closed within SLA, and controls that are checked automatically.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Maturity reporting:** Run the monthly security maturity cycle for every product and platform: collect evidence, score each product against the security requirements list, publish the report, and keep the Cloud Portal security dashboard current. Move scores from self-assessment to automated evidence wherever tooling allows.
* **Product Security Guild:** Support the Product Security Guild day to day: onboard product security champions, run working sessions, answer questions on the requirements, and keep the requirements list and its guidance up to date.
* **Application security tooling:** Integrate, tune, and operate SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in Azure DevOps and GitHub pipelines. Keep signal high and noise low, triage findings with engineering teams, and track remediation against SLAs in Azure DevOps.
* **Threat modeling:** Facilitate threat modeling sessions with product teams using the architect's templates, record the results, and turn the agreed mitigations into backlog items.
* **Cloud security guardrails:** Implement the Azure guardrails the architect designs: Azure Policy definitions and assignments, Defender for Cloud configuration, and private networking standards, held as code in Bicep or Terraform. Triage cloud security posture findings and drive them to closure with the Cloud Platform team.
* **Secrets management:** Help roll out vault-based secret storage and rotation, and run secret detection so credentials stay out of source code and pipelines.
* **Identity and tenant isolation testing:** Build and run automated tests for customer-facing identity and tenant isolation, so a release that lets one customer reach another's data fails before it ships.
* **Pentest remediation:** Track penetration test and red-team findings from intake to verified fix, coordinate retests, and report status to the architect.
* **Audit evidence and questionnaires:** Gather product and cloud evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001, draft answers to customer security questionnaires for review, and keep a reusable answer library current.
* **Incident support:** Support containment and investigation inside the product and Azure estate during security incidents, working within the CISO-led incident response process.
* **AI-assisted delivery:** Use Claude Code and agentic workflows as a default way of working for evidence collection, finding triage, policy authoring, and reporting. Review AI-generated code and configuration before it reaches production, and own the result.
* **And other duties as assigned.**

  

**What to Bring:**

Security engineering experience (required): At least four years in application security, cloud security, or DevSecOps, with a total of five to eight years in software engineering, platform engineering, or security roles. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field.

Secure SDLC tooling (required): Hands-on experience integrating and tuning SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines, with tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk, Mend, GitHub Advanced Security, Microsoft Defender for DevOps, or OWASP ZAP. You can tell a real finding from a false positive and explain the fix to a developer.

Azure security (required): Working experience with Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, network security groups, private endpoints, and Key Vault. You have written or changed infrastructure as code in Bicep or Terraform.

Application security knowledge (required): Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, common web and API vulnerabilities, and how they are fixed in code. Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.

Scripting and automation (required): Confident with Python or PowerShell for automating checks, pulling data from APIs, and building reports. Comfortable with Azure DevOps or GitHub for pipelines and work tracking.

AI-assisted working methods (required): Demonstrated delivery using AI coding and automation tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, with the judgment to review and verify what they produce. Claude Code experience is strongly preferred.

Certifications (strongly preferred): At least one Azure certification, such as AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer, AZ-104 Azure Administrator or SC-100 Cybersecurity Architect, and at least one security certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP, GIAC (GWAPT, GCSA), CSSLP or CISSP.

Compliance awareness: Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence collection and to customer security questionnaires.

Communication: Clear written and spoken English. You can work with engineering teams across time zones, explain why a finding matters, and keep work moving across teams.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products and tenant isolation testing.
* Experience securing AI and LLM applications, including prompt injection and data leakage risks.
* Container and Kubernetes security, including image scanning and admission policies.
* Microsoft Sentinel or KQL for detection and investigation.
* Background in energy, utilities, or other critical-infrastructure industries.

  

**Additional Details**

Hours of operation: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM CT (UTC

* 6) / 5:30 PM – 2:30 AM IST (UTC+5:30), a nine-hour day. IST hours move one hour earlier while the US is on daylight saving time.
Shift timing: After six months, we may evaluate moving to a second shift of 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM CT (UTC* 6) / 12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST (UTC+5:30).
* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

  

**Success in the First 90 Days**

* The first monthly maturity report published, with every product and platform scored once against requirements list v1.
* Security champions named in each product and platform group, with a regular Guild working session running.
* SAST, SCA, and secrets scanning running in the pipelines of at least two products, with findings flowing into Azure DevOps and remediation SLAs agreed.
* All open penetration test findings logged in Azure DevOps with owners, due dates, and a weekly status view for the architect.
* A reusable customer security questionnaire answer library in place, covering the most common product and cloud questions.
