title: Cybersecurity Architect
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

### **Job Details**

Cybersecurity Architect

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Architect to design, implement, and strengthen enterprise security architecture across applications, cloud environments, AI-driven solutions, and network access infrastructure.

The individual will work closely with application development, cloud engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle while ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient technology environments.

The role requires a combination of strategic security architecture expertise and hands-on technical capabilities, particularly in Application Security, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, AI Security, Zero Trust Architecture, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

  
  

Key Responsibilities

A. Application Security & Architecture

Perform application security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modeling for enterprise applications and services.

Identify security vulnerabilities, architectural weaknesses, and potential attack vectors.

Define secure application architecture principles and recommend appropriate security controls.

Provide remediation guidance to development teams for identified vulnerabilities.

Establish and promote secure coding practices and application security standards.

Evaluate application security risks across APIs, microservices, web applications, and cloud-native workloads.

B. DevSecOps & Pipeline Security Automation

Integrate automated security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines without significantly impacting release velocity.

Implement and manage Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and container security scanning.

Integrate security checks into build, deployment, and release processes.

Define security gates, vulnerability thresholds, and remediation workflows.

Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to establish security-as-code practices.

Support automation of vulnerability detection, reporting, and compliance validation.

C. Zero Trust Security Architecture

Design and implement Zero Trust security architecture across applications, services, users, and infrastructure.

Define identity-centric security controls, least-privilege access, and continuous authentication and authorization mechanisms.

Implement secure access strategies for applications, APIs, workloads, and enterprise services.

Define micro-segmentation and secure communication patterns between services.

Establish policies for identity governance, privileged access, and access monitoring.

  
  

D. Cloud Security

Design and assess security architecture across cloud environments, particularly AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.

Define cloud security controls covering IAM, network security, encryption, key management, logging, monitoring, and workload protection.

Implement cloud security best practices and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM).

Assess cloud infrastructure configurations against security standards and industry frameworks.

Support secure architecture for cloud-native applications, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless workloads.

E. AI Security

Assess security risks associated with AI/ML applications, Generative AI solutions, and enterprise AI platforms.

Define security controls for AI workloads, models, APIs, and data pipelines.

Address risks related to prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, insecure model integrations, and unauthorized access.

Establish security guardrails for LLM applications, AI agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions.

Define secure AI governance, data protection, model access controls, and AI risk assessment practices.

F. Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)

Design and evaluate ZTNA solutions to provide secure, identity-based access to enterprise applications and resources.

Define access policies based on user identity, device posture, contextual risk, and application sensitivity.

Integrate ZTNA solutions with enterprise identity providers, MFA, and endpoint security platforms.

Evaluate traditional VPN replacement strategies and application-level access controls.

Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to implement secure remote access architecture.

  
  

G. Healthcare Data Security & HIPAA Compliance

Design and implement security controls to protect sensitive healthcare information and Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI) across applications, cloud environments, and data integrations.

Ensure appropriate technical safeguards are implemented to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of healthcare information.

Collaborate with application, cloud, and infrastructure teams to identify and mitigate security risks associated with the storage, processing, and transmission of ePHI.

Define and implement controls for secure data access, encryption, audit logging, data integrity, and secure information exchange.

Support security risk assessments and remediation activities related to HIPAA compliance requirements.

  
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills

Strong experience in Cybersecurity Architecture and enterprise security design.

Hands-on expertise in Application Security, threat modeling, and architecture risk assessments.

Practical experience with DevSecOps and security automation in CI/CD pipelines.

Knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, and vulnerability management tools.

Strong understanding of Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, RBAC, ABAC, MFA, and least-privilege principles.

Experience in Cloud Security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI security risks and mitigation strategies.

Experience with ZTNA architecture and implementation.

Knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-207, ISO 27001, OWASP Top 10, and OWASP API Security Top 10.

  
  

Good-to-Have Skills

Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent.

Experience with tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, SonarQube, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent.

Experience with ZTNA solutions such as Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudflare Zero Trust, or Netskope.

Knowledge of Kubernetes security, service mesh security, and API gateways.

Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

Experience in security governance, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance.

Experience in enterprise security architecture documentation and security reference models.

Experience & Qualifications

10–15 years of overall experience in Information Security / Cybersecurity.

Significant experience in designing and implementing enterprise security architecture.

Demonstrated experience working with application development, DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure teams.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Job Purpose

The Intermediate Analyst is responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving digital asset transactions processed by makers, while also executing complex or high-value instructions independently. This role ensures operational accuracy, security compliance, and timely execution of transactions on blockchain networks. The Intermediate Analyst also provides guidance to junior team members and contributes to maintaining a strong control environment.

Job Background / Context

The Digital Asset Custody Operations team ensures precise execution and confirmation of token transfers, reconciliations, and settlement reporting. This role combines quality assurance, oversight, and advanced transaction handling, while still maintaining active involvement in settlement processing within a 24/7 shift model to ensure continuous operational coverage.

Key Responsibilities

* On-Chain Confirmation: Monitor blockchain explorers to ensure settlement completion within required timeframes through reviewing and validating instructions.
  

  

* Process Adherence: Approve settlement transactions within defined authorization limits, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and security protocols.

* Risk-Based handling: Execute high-value, urgent, or complex transactions requiring advanced verification steps.
  

  

* Reconciliation: Compare on-chain transaction records with internal custody and settlement systems, manage complex breaks and support escalation of open breaks according to breaks escalation protocol.
  

  

* Exception Handling: Investigate settlement exceptions, failed transactions, or delays, coordinating resolution with relevant teams.

title: Threat Management Lead
description:
Location: Pune Employment Type: full-time

### **Job Details**

  
  

**Position Summary**

The Threat Management Lead will be responsible for strengthening the organization's cybersecurity threat detection and response capabilities through proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, and

threat intelligence analysis. The role will lead initiatives to identify emerging cyber threats, develop and optimize security detection mechanisms, and improve visibility across the organization's IT infrastructure, applications,and cloud environments.

  
  

The individual will leverage internal security telemetry, external threat intelligence feeds, and industry threat-sharing communities to identify potential attack patterns, develop actionable detection strategies,

and proactively uncover adversarial activities that may bypass conventional security controls.

  
  
  

The role requires prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, along with strong expertise in threat detection, security monitoring, incident investigation, and threat hunting.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Detection Engineering**

* Design, develop, implement, and continuously fine-tune custom threat detection rules and use cases.
* Map detection capabilities and security monitoring coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Identify detection gaps across endpoints, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise environments.
* Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules,correlation logic, behavioral analytics, and automated alerts.
* Collaborate with SOC and incident response teams to improve detection accuracy and minimize false positives.
* Develop and enhance threat detection use cases to identify unauthorized access, suspicious activity, data exfiltration, and potential compromise involving sensitive healthcare information and patient data.
* Design and optimize security monitoring mechanisms to detect anomalous access patterns, potential data breaches, and threats targeting systems that store, process, or transmit Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
  

  

**Threat Intelligence Management**

* Collect, analyze, and operationalize threat intelligence from internal security telemetry, commercial intelligence feeds, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and Information Sharing and Analysis Centers (ISACs).
* Analyze emerging threat actors, attack techniques,indicators of compromise (IOCs), and adversarial tactics.
* Translate threat intelligence into actionable detection rules, threat-hunting hypotheses, and security priorities.
* Maintain awareness of evolving cyber threats,vulnerabilities, attack campaigns, and industry-specific risks.
* Establish processes for integrating threat intelligence into security monitoring and incident response operations.
  

  

**Proactive Threat Hunting**

* Lead proactive threat-hunting activities to identify suspicious behavior and advanced adversarial activities that may bypass automated security tools.
* Develop threat-hunting hypotheses based on intelligence reports, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and observed security events.
* Investigate abnormal activities across endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud environments.
* Perform advanced log analysis, event correlation, and behavioral analysis to uncover hidden threats.
* Document hunting findings and translate identified threats into improved detection mechanisms and security controls.
  

  

**SOC Operations & Incident Investigation**

* Leverage previous SOC Analyst experience to support security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, and threat analysis.
* Work closely with SOC analysts and incident response teams to improve threat detection and investigation processes.
* Support root cause analysis of security incidents and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
* Improve SOC detection maturity through continuous feedback, knowledge sharing, and process optimization.
  

  

**Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to SOC analysts and threat detection engineers.
* Establish detection engineering and threat-hunting standards, methodologies, and operational metrics.
* Track detection coverage, threat-hunting effectiveness, false-positive rates, and detection gaps.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application security, and security operations teams to strengthen the organization's overall security posture.
  

  

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with prior hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst.
* Strong experience in threat detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and proactive threat hunting.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Experience developing, implementing, and tuning custom detection rules and correlation use cases.
* Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, application, and cloud security monitoring.
* Experience analyzing IOCs, security logs, behavioral patterns, and threat intelligence feeds.
* Strong understanding of security incident investigation, malware behavior, attack patterns, and cyber threat landscape.
* Ability to translate threat intelligence and hunting findings into actionable detection capabilities.
* Understanding of security threats and monitoring requirements relevant to healthcare environments, including threats targeting patient information, healthcare applications, and systems containing Electronic Protected Health Information (ePHI).
* Knowledge of healthcare data security, patient information protection, and security monitoring requirements associated with sensitive healthcare information.
* Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, or Sentinel One.
* Knowledge of detection languages and framework such as Sigma, YARA, KQL, SPL, or EQL.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
* Understanding of cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Relevant certifications such as GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), or equivalent.
* Experience working with commercial threat intelligence platforms and ISAC communities, HIPAA awareness
  

  

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* 8–10 years of relevant cybersecurity experience.
* Prior experience working in a Security Operations Center (SOC) is mandatory.
* Experience leading or mentoring technical security teams is preferred.

title: Sr Analyst, Cyber Security Threat Management
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

As part of Northern Trust’s security operations center, a Senior Analyst will conduct security monitoring, security incident identification, incident prioritization, incident escalation and directed response support functions. Tier one analyst will play a crucial role in executing Northern Trust’s 24x7 security monitoring model, creating a resilient and unified team that improves NT’s ability to protect and defend its networks and information.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR/XDR, email, identity, network, and cloud security tools.
* Analyze security events to determine incident scope, severity, and business impact.
* Coordinate containment, remediation, escalation, and incident tracking through closure.
* Conduct threat hunting and identify opportunities to improve detections, runbooks, and playbooks.
* Maintain accurate investigation records and provide effective handovers across global SOC teams.
* Support major incidents, post-incident reviews, and operational reporting.
* Provide technical guidance and investigation support to junior analysts.
* Collaborate with regional and global cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity, cloud, and technology teams.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Practical knowledge of incident response processes, MITRE ATT&CK, networking, and common cyberattack techniques.
* Experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, email security, identity security, and ServiceNow.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, KQL, threat intelligence, or security automation is preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently within a shift-based, 24x7, or follow-the-sun operating model.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Lead, Internal Audit - IT Operations & Cybersecurity
description:
**Job Title:**

Lead, Internal Audit - IT Operations & Cybersecurity

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary**

The Lead, IT Operations & Cybersecurity Audit is a strategic leader within the Internal Audit function responsible for advancing the organization's technology risk assurance capabilities. This role provides subject matter expertise and leadership across IT operations, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, infrastructure, identity and access management, SAP technology risks, and digital transformation initiatives.

As a senior member of the Internal Audit team, this individual will lead complex technology-focused audits, influence enterprise risk management strategies, and partner with senior leaders across Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Finance, and Operations. The role will help establish and mature a scalable technology assurance program capable of addressing Entegris' evolving digital risk landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technology Risk Assurance Leadership**

  

* Lead the development and execution of the Internal Audit technology assurance strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and emerging risk areas.
* Serve as the primary Internal Audit subject matter expert for technology operations, cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud environments, identity and access management, and technology governance.
* Provide strategic recommendations to Internal Audit leadership regarding technology risk trends, emerging threats, and assurance priorities.
* Support the continuous enhancement of audit methodologies to address evolving technology and cybersecurity risks.

**IT and Cybersecurity Audits**

  

* Lead complex audits and advisory engagements covering IT general controls (ITGCs), cybersecurity, cloud platforms, infrastructure environments, network security, privileged access management, and technology operations.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control frameworks supporting enterprise technology functions.
* Assess cybersecurity programs, incident response capabilities, vulnerability management processes, and third-party technology risks.
* Perform technology-focused investigations and special reviews as needed.

**SAP and Digital Transformation Risk Management**

  

* Lead risk assessments and assurance activities related to SAP S/4HANA, enterprise applications, automation initiatives, and digital transformation programs.
* Evaluate technology risks associated with system implementations, migrations, upgrades, and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Assess automated controls and technology-enabled business processes for operational effectiveness and risk mitigation.
* Provide assurance over business-critical technology platforms and supporting control environments.

**SOX and Compliance Support**

  

* Partner with management and external auditors to support SOX compliance activities related to IT general controls and automated controls.
* Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness across key technology processes supporting financial reporting.
* Contribute technology expertise to enterprise compliance and regulatory initiatives.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to improve control efficiency while maintaining regulatory compliance.

**Continuous Assurance and Analytics**

  

* Lead development of technology risk dashboards, monitoring tools, and continuous assurance capabilities.
* Partner with Internal Audit analytics resources to identify opportunities for automation and continuous monitoring.

* Leverage data-driven insights to improve audit coverage, enhance risk detection, and increase assurance effectiveness.
* Promote innovative approaches to technology risk management and audit execution.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration**

  

* Build strong partnerships with leaders across Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Compliance, Finance, Operations, and other business functions.
* Coordinate technology assurance activities with external auditors and third-party assessors.
* Influence stakeholders to strengthen risk management practices and address control gaps.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology and cybersecurity risk matters.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Internal Audit, IT Audit, Cybersecurity, Technology Risk Management, Information Security, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technology audit engagements across multiple risk domains.
* Strong knowledge of IT general controls, cybersecurity frameworks, cloud technologies, infrastructure operations, identity and access management, and technology governance.
* Experience assessing enterprise applications, ERP systems, and automated controls.
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments and related technology controls.
* Experience assessing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, CIS Controls, and other recognized cybersecurity and governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting public company SOX compliance programs.
* Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CIA, CPA, or equivalent.
* Experience operating in a global, geographically dispersed organization.

**Leadership Expectations**

  

* Serves as a recognized expert in technology risk, cybersecurity, and technology assurance.
* Leads enterprise-wide initiatives and influences strategy beyond immediate functional responsibilities.
* Exercises significant independent judgment in addressing highly complex business and technology challenges.
* Builds credibility with senior leaders and acts as a trusted advisor on technology risk matters.
* Drives innovation, capability development, and continuous improvement across the Internal Audit function.
* Mentors and develops less experienced team members while elevating overall technical expertise within the organization.

**Success Measures**

**This role will be successful by:**

  

* Strengthening Internal Audit's technology and cybersecurity assurance capabilities.
* Providing meaningful risk insights related to cloud, cybersecurity, infrastructure, SAP, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Improving technology risk visibility through continuous assurance and monitoring capabilities.
* Supporting effective SOX compliance and technology control governance.
* Building strong partnerships across global technology and business organizations.
* Establishing sustainable, scalable technology assurance processes aligned with Entegris' long-term digital transformation strategy.

**Location**

**Pune, India**

Pune offers access to a highly skilled talent market with deep expertise in technology risk, cybersecurity, SAP, cloud technologies, and technology consulting. The location enables efficient global support across Asia, Europe, and North America while helping establish a scalable center of excellence for technology assurance and cybersecurity risk oversight.

description:

**Summary**

Northern Trust Technology Cybersecurity GRC function is responsible for enabling Global Cybersecurity to strong 1st Line of Defense, foster a control aware culture, deliver compliant and secure technology capabilities, protect customers and meet regulatory requirements. The Lead role is part of the Cybersecurity GRC Team, responsible for leading and supporting risk and control assessments for core cyber security domains, performing security testing, and evaluating compliance to information security policies and procedures and regulatory requirements. The role will work directly with cybersecurity, Infrastructure and business units’ teams providing guidance to implement defense-in-depth controls to protect Northern Trust and the customers. As well as working with a dynamic team and contributing to the overall cyber security of the firm.

**Major Duties***include but not limited to;*

  

* Advise and support risk and control assessments for core cyber security domains
* Lead remediation of cyber security findings from various sources

**Knowledge** **/Skills/Abilities/Experience** **&** ***Desirable Criteria include;***

* Strong knowledge across core cybersecurity domains, including IAM, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security and Cyber GRC.

* Analytical, consultative and communication skills with ability to communicate control requirements to partners in terms easily understood
* Organized and time management skills, with ability to produce high-quality timely deliverables
* Flexible approach towards changing work methods, deadlines and variable workloads.
* Ability to adapt and react timely and positively in a changing and dynamic work environment.
* Expertise in Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn new tools as needed.
* Applicable industry standard certification(s) desired
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline and technical experience in the security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications and network protocols or an equivalent combination of education and work experience

**Major Duties**:

  

* Provides consultative support, best practice guidance and support to internal/external teams to Cybersecurity , Technology and Business Units staff in risk assessments, implement.
* Identifies, evaluates, conducts, schedules and leads technical analyses functions to ensure all applicable Cybersecurity requirements are met.
* Participates in the evaluation, development, implementation, communication, monitoring and maintenance of Cybersecurity policies and procedures.
* May act as Project Leader with servant leadership approach
* May be involved in helping and training to other specialists and team members on .
* Keeping abreast on the direction of emerging industry standards.
* Provides technical analysis of requirements necessary for the protection of all information processed, stored, or transmitted by systems.
* Serves as an expert resource or ¿go to person¿ within a group.
* Conduct preliminary analysis.
* Review work of others.
* Handles more extensive, high-profile work.
* Responsible for direct interaction with different committees and/or management.  
    
  **Knowledge:**

Is a technical expert with in-depth knowledge in area of expertise and strong knowledge of other areas. Requires excellent analytical ability, consultation and communication skills, strong judgment and the ability to work effectively with clients, IT management and staff, vendors and consultants.  
  
**Experience:**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline and at least four, typically six or more years of technical experience in the security aspects of multiple platforms, operating systems, software, communications and network protocols or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and support risk and control assessments across cybersecurity domains, including Identity and Access Management, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber GRC.
* Plan, conduct, and oversee cybersecurity control evidence collection, risk identification, evidence validation, and control gap analysis.
* Lead the identification, assessment, tracking, validation, and closure of cybersecurity issues and control gaps, ensuring timely and sustainable remediation.
* Review cybersecurity findings from control testing, risk assessments, audits, regulatory reviews, and other assurance activities, and work with control owners to develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Map cybersecurity controls to applicable risks, Issues/IPTs, regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and internal policies and procedures.
* Evaluate evidence against control descriptions, documented procedures, Issues/IPTs, risk statements, and regulatory requirements to determine whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
* Provide technical and risk-management guidance to Cybersecurity, Technology, Infrastructure, Business, and IT Management teams regarding control implementation and defense-in-depth security practices.
* Participate in the development, implementation, communication, monitoring, and maintenance of cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements.
* Support technical engagements involving security threats and vulnerabilities, penetration testing, software security testing, Cloud Security, and other emerging cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct cybersecurity maturity assessments, identify capability gaps, and recommend practical improvement opportunities aligned with organizational risk appetite and industry practices.
* Serve as a cybersecurity risk and control subject matter expert and act as the primary point of contact for complex or high-profile risk and control matters.
* Lead technical analyses and risk-based reviews to ensure applicable information security and regulatory requirements are appropriately addressed.
* Review the quality and completeness of work performed by team members and provide guidance, training, and technical assistance to junior specialists.
* Lead or support cybersecurity risk and control projects, coordinate activities across multiple stakeholders, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
* Prepare and present clear risk assessments, control testing results, remediation updates, and management-level reporting to senior stakeholders and governance committees.
* Maintain awareness of emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory expectations, technologies, and industry standards, and assess their potential impact on the organization’s control environment.

**Required Knowledge and Skills**

  

* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity domains, including IAM, Data Protection, Vulnerability Management, Threat Management, Incident Response, Application Security, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Cyber GRC.
* Strong understanding of technology risk management, cybersecurity controls, control testing, audit methodologies, and design and operating effectiveness assessments.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity and risk management frameworks, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST Risk Management Framework, CRI Profile, and APQC
* Understanding relevant regulatory requirements, including CHIPS, CHAPS, and FRB-related requirements.
* Experience with issue management and remediation processes, including issue identification, risk assessment, action-plan development, tracking, validation, and closure.
* Experience working within the First, Second, or Third Line of Defense, particularly in cybersecurity control testing, independent validation, risk management, or audit activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technology risks and recommend practical solutions.
* Excellent consultative, stakeholder-management, and communication skills, with the ability to explain cybersecurity risks and control requirements in clear business language.
* Ability to interact effectively with technical subject matter experts, IT management, business stakeholders, vendors, consultants, senior management, and governance committees.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage changing priorities, variable workloads, and multiple deadlines while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
* Strong judgment and the ability to independently manage complex, sensitive, and high-profile cybersecurity risk matters.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn and effectively use new risk-management and cybersecurity tools.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Typically six or more years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology risk management, information security, control testing, audit, or related areas.
* Technical or audit experience across multiple platforms, operating systems, applications, communication technologies, and network protocols is preferred.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cybersecurity, risk-management, or audit certifications are desirable. The source document requires applicable industry certifications but does not prescribe specific certifications.

**Leadership Expectations**

The role is expected to operate as a technical expert, reviewer, project lead, and trusted advisor. The individual should be capable of independently handling complex assignments, guiding junior team members, reviewing the work of others, engaging with management and governance committees, and influencing stakeholders to improve the organization’s cybersecurity risk and control environment.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

The role is directly assigned to enterprise AI projects, embedding security into the design, build, and deployment of web applications, AI agents, and their integrations with enterprise data and systems. Working closely with development and platform teams, the AI Security Engineer applies Microsoft security capabilities and AI security best practice to identify risks, define practical security requirements, and confirm the right controls are in place before and after release.

  

**What will you be doing?**

* Serve as the dedicated security engineer on assigned enterprise AI projects, supporting delivery teams from design through deployment and ongoing operation.

* Perform threat modelling and security design reviews for web applications, AI agents, copilots, and their integrations with enterprise data and systems.

### **Description and Requirements**

**Role Value Proposition :** MetLife is the leading provider of Group Benefits. The Group Disability technology organization is a diverse team of technologists, all working towards the common goal of ensuring the customer is at the center of everything we do. As a Sr Software Dev Engineer Tester in the Group Disability technology organization, you will be responsible for conducting thorough, hands-on testing to ensure the functionality and quality of our deliverables. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to identify and resolve issues, ensuring development deliverables meet both functional and user experience standards. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and a passion for delivering high-quality results. As a Sr Software engineer in test, you are responsible for the design, development, implementation and maintenance of solutions supporting Disability & Absence products at MetLife - products that provide income protection and job protection to millions of employees across the United States. You will collaborate closely with the Scrum Lead, Product Owner and ART Leadership. You will have an opportunity to impact every part of the system and iterate over solutions to be the very best you can be to deliver for our customers.

You will be responsible for thought leadership, creative problem solving, and applying your expertise in a complex environment. Your responsibilities include writing full stack code, reviewing code written by the team, design and development of systems, frameworks, applications, and APIs.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Partners with software engineers to write efficient test automation code using coding standards and best practices. Writes manual test where automated is not supported.
* Assist in Software Architectural Design.
* Develop/enhance and document automated testing framework, tools and dashboards
* Leads the planning and documenting test strategies and acceptance criteria based on customer needs
* Leads and participates in test execution (new builds and regression), test suite grooming, analyze the reports, troubleshoot & investigate the failures. Performs peer reviews of automation codebase.
* Investigate, diagnose and repair problems, testing bugs, and creating and managing bug reports.
* Understanding the business processes at the feature level to pro-actively look for ways to innovate and improve the testing process to gain efficiencies.
  

  

**Expected behaviors:**

* A self-starter capable of acting independently and proactively requiring minimal management oversight.
* Ability to work across cultures and geographies to encourage team to adopt best practices
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience in the Insurance industry, preferably with knowledge of Disability products and related business processes.
* Hands-on experience with DevSecOps practices, tools, and AI-powered solutions such as Microsoft Copilot.
* Proven experience testing Web, Mobile, Data-Intensive, and Responsive Web applications.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional, geographically distributed teams.
* Experience working in SAFe and Agile environments, with an understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and their integration with traditional Waterfall practices.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quality engineering skills.
* Experience collaborating with business stakeholders, developers, and product teams in an Agile environment.
* Knowledge of test automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
  

  

**Technical Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience delivering large-scale, complex software projects with demonstrated technical leadership in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, and AI-enabled testing initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and quality engineering principles.
* Hands-on experience with various testing types including functional, regression, integration, system, API, end-to-end, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Proficient in designing and maintaining comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and quality metrics aligned with business requirements.
* Experience with Test-Driven Development, Behavior-Driven Development, Shift-Left Testing, and Continuous Testing practices.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and automated regression testing methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with Tosca, Playwright, Azure DevOps, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience leveraging AI/GenAI technologies to improve software quality, including AI-powered test case generation, test data creation, defect analysis, root cause identification, and test optimization.
* Understanding of Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI Agents, and Responsible AI practices in software development and testing workflows.
* Experience validating and testing AI/ML applications, including model performance, accuracy, bias detection, explainability, security, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Product Owners, Developers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and AI Engineers to ensure delivery of high-quality solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to drive quality improvements across enterprise applications and AI-powered systems.
  

  

**Experience:** 8-12 Years

**About MetLife**  
  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  
  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI-enabled, people-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long-term value.

  

Our purpose is simple - to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values - Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead - we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. At MetLife, it’s #AllTogetherPossible. Join us!

title: Digital S/W Eng Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital S/W Engineer Sr Analyst Shape, build, and govern high-impact API solutions as a Senior Systems Engineer, sitting at the intersection of hands-on Apigee development and API design leadership within Citi's Digital Engineering organization. In this hybrid technical role, you will both develop and configure production API solutions on Google Apigee and lead the design and specification of API interfaces and integration patterns — owning mid-size features end-to-end from architecture through deployment, while contributing to larger platform initiatives.

  
  

You will be equally comfortable configuring Apigee proxies and policies as you are producing API design artefacts, leading design reviews, and governing integration standards. This role sits within Citi's Wealth Digital engineering team, where your contributions will directly shape API quality, security posture, and delivery outcomes at scale.

  
  

Responsibilities

  
  

Apigee

* Design and configure API proxies on Google Apigee, including proxy configurations, flow definitions, route rules, and target endpoint setup.

* Define and maintain Apigee policies — including traffic management (quota, spike arrest, rate limiting), mediation (JSON-to-XML, message transformation), and security (OAuth, API key validation, JWT verification) policies.

* Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) authorization flows natively within Apigee, including authorization code, client credentials, and token introspection patterns.

* Configure and manage Apigee environments, API products, developer portals, and monetization configurations in line with platform governance standards.

* Integrate Apigee with backend services, identity providers, and downstream systems through secure, performant target configurations.

  
  

API Design & Governance

* Lead the design and specification of RESTful APIs, producing OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, API contracts, and integration specifications that engineering teams implement against.

* Apply Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles in both API design specifications and Apigee proxy configurations to protect sensitive financial data exchanges.

* Apply knowledge of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CDR, Section 1033) to design and build compliant, interoperable API interfaces on the Apigee platform.

* Define and enforce API design standards and governance guidelines, governing APIGEE Products and Proxies ,including naming conventions, versioning strategies, error response schemas, and pagination patterns.

* Facilitate and lead API design reviews and architecture walkthroughs, providing well-reasoned recommendations that guide engineering implementation decisions.

* Produce technical diagrams — sequence diagrams, flow diagrams, and system context maps — to document API behavior, data flows, Apigee policy execution, and integration touchpoints.

  
  

Leadership & Collaboration

* Communicate technical progress and risks proactively across engineering and product teams, managing competing priorities and keeping stakeholders aligned.

* Review delivery and API quality metrics regularly, identifying opportunities to improve development workflows, proxy performance, and governance processes.

* Mentor and upskill junior engineers through code reviews, proxy design walkthroughs, and structured knowledge-sharing sessions.

* Evaluate technical and business risk in design and implementation decisions, escalating issues with transparency to protect Citi and its clients.

  
  

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in a product development, engineering, or technology product management environment, including 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and configuring APIs on Google Apigee (proxies, flow configurations, policy chaining, shared flows, and target endpoints).

* Advanced expertise in RESTful API design & architecture, OpenAPI 3.x specification authoring, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Deep knowledge of API security & identity standards, including OAuth 2.0 (OAuthV2 policies, Client Credentials), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Financial-grade API (FAPI) security profiles across API contracts and Apigee configurations.

* Strong understanding of Open Banking regulations (e.g., PSD2, CFPB Section 1033) and global data privacy frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) to ensure compliant, interoperable interface design.

* Skilled in vendor and partner management, effectively collaborating with third-party service providers to evaluate tools and drive solution delivery.

* Hands-on delivery in Agile environments, applying Scrum/Kanban practices to lead cross-functional sprint teams from concept through deployment.

* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with a data-driven, results-oriented approach to resolving complex system challenges and optimizing delivery metrics.

* Working familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Devin.AI) and prompt engineering methodologies to improve design velocity and documentation quality.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven capability to influence both senior technical and business stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design walkthroughs.

Education

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Landscape :** SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.

The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.

  

**Key Accountability Areas**

Area - Expected Ownership

* **SAP User Access Management** : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* **SAP Role Management** : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* **SAP GRC Access Control** : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* **SAP GRC Process Control** : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* **SAP IDM** : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* **Access Reviews and Audit**s : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* **Risk Ruleset Management** : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* **SAP Native Security** : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

  

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* **SAP User Access Management**
  + Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
  + Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
  + Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
  + Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
  + Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.
* **SAP Role Management**
  + Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
  + Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
  + Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
  + Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
  + Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.
* **SAP GRC Access Control Management**
  + Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
  + Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
  + Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
  + Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
  + Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.
* **SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management**
  + Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
  + Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
  + Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
  + Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
  + Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.
* **SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management**
  + Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
  + Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
  + Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
  + Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
  + Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.
* **SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews**
  + Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
  + Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
  + Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
  + Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
  + Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.
* **SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates**
  + Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
  + Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
  + Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
  + Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
  + Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.
* **SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management**
  + Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
  + Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
  + Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
  + Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
  + Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.
* **Country Rollouts and Release Support**
  + Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
  + Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
  + Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
  + Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
  + Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.
* **SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support**
  + Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
  + Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
  + Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
  + Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
  + Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Google SecOps Engineer to lead and deliver Google Security Operations (SecOps) implementation, migration, detection engineering, parser development, and SOAR automation initiatives. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities, successful execution of end-to-end migration projects, and expertise in YARA-L detection engineering. This role is critical for driving SIEM/SOAR modernization programs, enhancing security monitoring capabilities, and supporting enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC).

  

* **Role: Senior Google SecOps Engineer**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: Between 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Lead end-to-end migrations from legacy SIEM and SOAR platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight, LogRhythm, Exabeam, Cortex XSOAR, and Phantom to Google SecOps.
* Conduct discovery, assessment, planning, onboarding, implementation, testing, tuning, and migration validation activities.
* Design and implement scalable log ingestion architectures across cloud, network, endpoint, IAM, security, and application data sources.
* Develop custom parsers, parser extensions, UDM mappings, and telemetry normalization solutions.
* Design, develop, and optimize YARA-L detection rules to improve threat detection effectiveness.
* Convert detection content from SPL, KQL, AQL, Sigma, ArcSight rule formats, and other SIEM technologies into YARA-L.
* Build, migrate, and optimize SOAR playbooks, workflows, and security automation use cases.
* Integrate security tools and platforms using APIs for enrichment, triage, containment, remediation, and notifications.
* Support threat hunting, incident response investigations, forensic analysis, and SOC operations.
* Develop migration frameworks, onboarding standards, runbooks, validation plans, and operational documentation.
* Collaborate with security analysts, architects, engineers, and stakeholders to improve security monitoring capabilities.
* Perform detection tuning, alert optimization, and use-case enhancement activities.
* Assist organizations in strengthening threat detection, response, and security operations maturity.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-12 years of experience in Cybersecurity, SIEM Engineering, SOAR Engineering, SOC Operations, Incident Response, or Detection Engineering.
* Minimum 1+ year of hands-on experience with Google SecOps implementations and operations.
* Proven experience delivering at least one full-cycle Google SecOps migration project.
* Strong expertise in Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with log onboarding, parser development, parser extensions, UDM mapping, and telemetry normalization.
* Strong experience developing YARA-L detection content from scratch.
* Expertise in converting detection rules from Splunk SPL, Microsoft KQL, Sigma, QRadar AQL, ArcSight, and other SIEM technologies.
* Experience designing and implementing SOAR automation workflows and security orchestration use cases.
* Strong understanding of threat detection, threat hunting, SOC operations, and incident response processes.
* Experience integrating EDR, IAM, Cloud Security, Vulnerability Management, Email Security, and Security Operations platforms.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party security tool integrations.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, security monitoring practices, and enterprise security architecture.
* Experience performing security use-case development, alert tuning, and operational optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

  

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of a Lead Security Engineer at Coupa:**

Coupa's Security Engineering team protects our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data at scale. As Lead Security Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader on the Security Engineering team — architecting and building cloud security controls, setting engineering standards, and partnering closely with Engineering, IT, and Compliance to ship durable, automated security tooling rather than one-off fixes. You thrive on ambiguity, sweat the implementation details, and take pride in solutions that scale across hundreds of accounts and services.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Architect and build multi cloud security controls across Coupa's cloud environment. VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, IAM policy design using least-privilege and permission boundaries, and Organizations/SCPs for guardrails at scale.

* Build policy-as-code and IaC security guardrails and wire them into CI/CD as pre-merge and pre-deploy gates rather than after the fact reviews.

* Harden containerized workloads - image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and runtime detection.

* Write auto-remediation for cloud misconfiguration and drift so common findings close without manual ticket routing.

* Own Vulnerability management program, act as the technical escalation point for security incidents and vulnerability findings - leading forensics, containment, and root-cause analysis using cloud-native and EDR tooling, and driving remediation to closure.

* Partner with Risk & Compliance to translate audit framework requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) into concrete technical controls, and automate evidence collection by integrating cloud telemetry with GRC tooling.

* Mentor other security engineers through design review, threat modeling, and code/architecture review; raise the technical bar for the whole team.

* Own reference architectures, threat models, and runbooks for the security tooling you build; participate in and help improve the on-call rotation.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**

* 10+ years of security engineering experience, including significant hands-on work securing production cloud environments at scale, plus experience leading projects or mentoring other engineers.

* Deep, hands-on AWS security expertise - IAM, VPC/networking, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, and Organizations/SCPs; working knowledge of GCP or Azure security is a plus.

* Production experience with Terraform (or equivalent IaC) and policy-as-code frameworks, plus container/Kubernetes security tooling.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals - Python and/or Go, Git-based workflows, and building/maintaining CI/CD security integrations (SAST, DAST, SCA).

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms and vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Qualys, Tenable) - building detections and workflows, not just consuming dashboards.

* Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53) sufficient to translate control requirements into engineering work.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to write clear technical design docs and explain risk trade-offs to auditors and engineering leadership alike.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Relevant certifications a plus: CISSP, CCSP, CISA, or AWS/GCP security certifications.

* Some international travel may be required.

* Good understanding of financial accounting principles, ledger impacts, accruals, reserves, and financial statement reporting.

Strong alignment with Barclays Values and Mindset, demonstrating integrity, accountability, collaboration, and the confidence to challenge constructively while driving excellence.  

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  
  

* Knowledge of Product Control functions, including daily P&L production, attribution, reconciliation, valuation controls, and balance sheet substantiation.
* Knowledge of regulatory capital, market risk, counterparty credit risk, and valuation adjustments (XVA).
* Ability to analyze and explain P&L movements, risk exposures, and valuation changes to trading desks and senior stakeholders.
* Experience in Front Office support, Product Control, Valuations, Market Risk, or Financial Control functions within an investment bank.
* Familiarity with financial reporting, Global Accounting Standards, regulatory reporting, and audit requirements.

* Ability to challenge and investigate valuation, booking, or P&L discrepancies independently.
* Project management and process improvement experience, including automation and control enhancement initiatives.

This role will be based out of Pune.

To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.

**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.

* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
